description: Four knobs and one output that always carries the value of whichever knob was moved last, so that several mapped sources can reach one destination

params.text: One of four knobs, 0V to 10V; moving it makes the output follow it until another knob is moved

outputs.text: The value of whichever of the four knobs moved most recently

notes: the module is meant to be driven by mapping: map a different source to each knob, then map this output on to the one destination, using a module such as stoermelder's CV-MAP
the knobs have no printed labels; their hover texts read A, B, C and D
menu: Detect changes to same value — makes a knob count as moved even when it is set to the value it already had, such as by a double click back to its default
